method: Unchanged Wasm artifacts. Steady public WasmFunc.Invoke windows; one child at a time; alternate runtime order each launch; same operations per fixture in both runtimes; every result copied to preallocated storage inside timer and checked outside it; startup, compilation, setup and checksum validation excluded. Medians of launch medians; each launch median uses five batch averages after three warmups. No original function is admitted by shared scalar lowering. Explicit default bounds.
limits: Shared development host: unrelated builds overlapped parts of the first runs; retained rather than discarded. Follow-up runs are also retained. Deltas below 3% do not establish a gain or regression.
Pure select is opt-in. Report optional-repeat against branch default separately from main.
Code diagnostics do not measure execution time. The 41 ordinary timing-executable images also match the diagnostic images.
Initial broad host filter was stopped; a later overlapping host run was excluded. Only final focused runs are used.
Sequential raw/Caller controls initially varied by up to +9.82%; alternating six-launch checks range from -0.01% to +2.47%. No raw or Caller performance gain is claimed.
